Body.Content:
Microsoft OneDrive is introducing presentation mode in the OneDrive iOS app for users on iPad devices. Users select a new Presentation button in the PDF viewer to enter a focused, view-only experience that prevents free gesture scrolling between pages, reducing accidental page changes while presenting without moving the file to another app. The feature is not available on iPhone.

GA date: December CY2026
